{{Quote|Can you believe it? That's Prefect Gerom, talking with Dasar Zorm, who happens to be just the biggest racketeer on the entire ''planet''!|Hailey LaMelle, to Andross|<ref name="HR" />}}
'''Namore''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HR" /> located in the [[Namore system/Legends|Namore system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Gerom]] was an official on the planet who held the title of [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]]. [[Hailey LaMelle]] was considered to be Namore's most notable [[HoloNet/Legends|holonews]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]], while [[Dasar Zorm]] was a notorious local [[Racketeering|racketeer]].<ref name="HR" />

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Prefect Gerom met with Zorm on Namore. LaMelle and [[Andross]], her [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] operator, filmed the meeting from across a plaza. The reporter observed Zorm opening a suitcase containing [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], as well as Gerom handing the criminal what looked to LaMelle like a document pouch, all of which made her speculate that an act of bribery was taking place. At that point, LaMelle's observations were interrupted by an individual pressing the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] against her back.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Namore appeared in "[[Live And In (Bleeding) Color…]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Namore [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Namore, within grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
